info.description: The HTTP contract between the gateway backend and its control-plane clients (desktop app, web console). In local_guardrail mode the backend listens on loopback. Management routes require the local admin token when configured. In shared_boundary mode, protected routes require a bearer access token or the session cookie from /api/auth/login. Management routes require an admin principal. Every error response has the Error body.
